# K8.2 NVFP4 expert weight all-gather

Classification: Internal (becomes public with the MLPerf Training v6.1 results)

[Index](../KERNELS.md) · Switches: `NVFP4_FP4_AG=1`, `NVFP4_FP4_AG_CHECK=0`
(`config_GB300_2x4x3xtp1pp1cp1ep1_nvfp4_v7.sh` L110-111) · Class: **Bitwise** · Rule basis: TR-8.3; NVFP4 communication format (TR-5.2a)

## 1. Packages

G3, G6 and G6b, where named below, are Firmus's earlier GPT-OSS NVFP4 packages (`nemo_g3_nvfp4_v1`, `nemo_g6_nvfp4_v2`,
`nemo_g6b_nvfp4_v2_1`), withdrawn from this submission and no longer in this repository. Their values, line numbers,
images and test jobs are cited as the record of where evidence was collected ([Index](../KERNELS.md), "Earlier packages").

| | G6, G6b, G6c |
|---|---|
| Switches | `NVFP4_FP4_AG=1` (L110), `NVFP4_FP4_AG_CHECK=0` (L111); `NVFP4_FP4_AG_KERNEL` not set (default 1, V7 patch L1097) |
| Code | V7 patch (`nemo_g6c_nvfp4_v2_2/docker/patches/transformer_engine_firmus_v7.patch`) `nvfp4_fp4_ag.py` L1054-1724 and the `grouped_mlp.py` hook L460-464; `pretrain.py` L245-250 (G6/G6b L228-233) |

Same V7 patch file in G6, G6b and G6c; G6c's `pretrain.py` hook is the same text.

## 2. What the reference does

Megatron's distributed optimizer all-gathers each bucket's BF16 parameters after the step. Every
rank then casts all expert weights to NVFP4 (TE 2D 16×16 block quantization, round to nearest)
in the MoE forward; in this stack that cast is K6.1-K6.3 with the amax of K6.2.

## 3. What this implementation does

1. `install` (L1499-1616) patches the layer and DDP constructors, the optimizer's buffer layout,
   `start_param_sync` and `dist_all_gather_func`.
2. `tag_module` (L1116-1148) marks the 2-D BF16 `weight<N>` parameters of the experts of every
   layer outside the tail (`NUM_LAYERS_AT_END_IN_BF16=2`): 22 layers × 64 = 1408 weights.
3. `make_layout` (L1158-1240) gives the tagged weights their own buckets, one per layer, sized so
   every shard boundary falls on a 16-row boundary (`unit` = lcm(16 × cols), L1178).
4. Before a bucket's gather, `_prepare` (L1466-1490) casts this rank's rows of each weight with
   the full-tensor amax slot of K6.2 (`cast_local`, L1324-1358; one launch per bucket, K8.3).
5. The patched all-gather (L1571-1587) gathers four buffers (row data, row scales, column data,
   column scales) instead of BF16.
6. `lookup` (L1619-1681), called first in `_quantize_expert_weights_impl` (L460-464), returns
   persistent NVFP4 tensors over the gathered buffers, so the K6.1/K6.2 casts are skipped.

## 4. Why the result is the same

NVFP4 weights use 16×16 blocks and one FP32 per-tensor scale from the amax. A slice of whole
16-row blocks cast with the full-tensor amax produces the same blocks, scales and data as the
full cast, row-wise and column-wise; the gathered slices are the full cast. Bitwise.

## 5. Numerics

Quantizer of the local cast: `NVFP4Quantizer(rowwise, columnwise, with_2d_quantization=True,
stochastic_rounding=False)` (L1493-1496). Communication: NVFP4 data and E4M3 scales
(`MLPERF_COMM_PRECISION=nvfp4`, config L54). Gradient reduce-scatter stays BF16.

## 6. Shapes and fallbacks

- **Gate:** tagged = 2-D BF16 `weight<N>` of non-tail expert modules (L1124-1138), `numel %
  unit == 0` and `rows % 16 == 0` (L1179-1181); bucket `n % (32 × dp) == 0` (assert L1267);
  shard boundaries on 16 rows (assert L1282-1284); `NVTE_NVFP4_4OVER6` must be `none` (raises,
  L1511-1512).
- **Falls back:** weights failing L1180 are untagged silently and use the BF16 gather and the K6
  cast. While a bucket has no amax slots, `_prepare` returns and the gather stays BF16
  (L1473-1479, L1576-1580; counter `bf16_ag`, printed only with `NVFP4_FP4_AG_CHECK>0`).
  `lookup` returns `None` (K6 path) for weights it does not know (L1634-1636). An armed bucket
  without slots, a gather without a local cast, or a first use under graph capture raise
  (L1475, L1577-1578, L1646-1647).
- **Assumes:** (a) once a bucket is gathered in FP4, the BF16 rows outside the local shard are
  stale (docstring L1080-1082); nothing checks that no other code reads them (the K6.2 in-run
  check does, see K6.2). (b) Every rank holds the same amax slot values (K6.2's MAX all-reduce);
  otherwise the gathered pieces use different scales. Only `NVFP4_FP4_AG_CHECK` (off) compares
  across ranks (L1712-1718). (c) No weight is cut by a shard boundary and no scale tensor needs
  padding, so `fixup_entries` (L1414-1431) returns no pairs. With the submitted shapes this
  holds: a layer's bucket is 32 FC2 weights [2944, 2944] (184 units of 47 104 elements each)
  next to 32 FC1 weights [5888, 2944] (368 units), kept adjacent by L1140-1147; the layout adds
  64 padding elements in total (log L562: numel 21347201920, unpadded 21347201856), less than one unit, so the bucket is 17 664 units
  and its DP8 (2208-unit) or DP4 (4416-unit) shard boundaries fall between weights. TE's scale
  padding (rows to 128, scale columns to 4) is a no-op for 5888 and 2944. Otherwise `lookup` calls
  `nvfp4_shard_cast.BatchCopy2D` (L1668), which the image's `nvfp4_shard_cast.py` (L2363-2491)
  does not define: it would raise `AttributeError`, not give wrong values.
- **Check:** config L110. In all 10 `results/firmus_gb300_ngpu8_gptoss_g6c_nvfp4_v2_2/gpt_oss_20b/result_*.txt`: `NVFP4_FP4_AG layout:
  47 buckets, 1408 FP4 weights, unit 47104` (L562), `NVFP4_FP4_AG: DDP has 47 buckets, 22
  all-FP4` (L566) and `NVFP4_FP4_AG shard cast: ShardCastCUDA` (L2297); no traceback.

## 7. Code

- V7 patch `nvfp4_fp4_ag.py` L1054-1724; `grouped_mlp.py` `_v7_module` L338-356, hook L460-464.
- `nemo_g6c_nvfp4_v2_2/pretrain.py` L245-250 (installed before the other `start_param_sync` wrappers).
- `_v7_module` falls back to `NVFP4_V7_OV_DIR` (default `/opt/v7ov`, L349-354) only if the module
  is missing from the TE package; it is installed (image verify jobs 22541 and 22589 on the G6b image, built from the same patches and `Dockerfile`; not repeated on this image:
  `nvfp4_fp4_ag.py == production overlay`, `V7_OV_DIR env: None`) and no scored-run env file sets
  the variable (both records available on request).

## 8. Tests and evidence

- **Kernel test on the image** (Firmus test script `k8_2_slice_cast.py`, available on request),
  job 22446, runs a and b rc 0, 7 cases per run (G6 image); on this package's image job 22897: 7 cases, 1 with a difference (the fixture, 939 365 elements), run a vs b 20 digests equal.
  TE `nvfp4_quantize_with_amax` of 16-row slices with the full amax, stitched, vs the full cast:
  0 bytes differ. The one case with a difference is the fixture (slice amax instead of full
  amax): 4 of 4 outputs, 939 365 elements. Run a vs run b: all digests equal. Earlier jobs
  (22242; 22440 on captured weights, 827 559 936 elements): 0 differ; a cut
  not on 16 rows is rejected by TE.
- **In-run check, image, not scored** (job 22171, 544 steps):
  `NVFP4_FP4_AG_CHECK` 0 bad, 0 diverged.
  On this package's image, job 22923 (544 steps, `NVFP4_FP4_AG_CHECK=8`, `../KERNELS.md` section 9.2): `0 bad 0
  diverged` on every rank.
- **Training A/B** (300 steps): `NVFP4_FP4_AG=0` (22250) max |loss
  diff| 0.1217 to base; base vs base 0.0873-0.1192. Runs are not bitwise repeatable.

## 9. Open points

1. The consumers that may read the BF16 expert weights after the first FP4 gather are not
   enumerated (the K6.2 check is one); that none runs in the scored configuration is not shown.
2. `BatchCopy2D` is referenced but not defined (assumption (c)). The path is not reached with the
   submitted shapes.
